meta.title: useshortly — self-hosted link shortener
meta.description: Shorten links, track clicks and manage your organization's domains.

signIn.title: Sign in — useshortly
signIn.description: Sign in to your useshortly account to manage and track your links.

signUp.title: Create account — useshortly
signUp.description: Create a free account to start shortening and tracking your links.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email — useshortly
verifyEmail.description: Enter the code we sent you to confirm your email address.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password — useshortly
forgotPassword.description: Request a code to reset your useshortly password.

resetPassword.title: Reset password — useshortly
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your useshortly account.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least {{min}} characters
validation.passwordMax: Password must be at most {{max}} characters

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send you a code to reset it.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.description: Enter the code we sent to {{email}} and choose a new password.
resetPassword.success: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.description: Enter the code we sent to {{email}} to finish creating your account.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Click analytics of one link. Days and hours are in UTC.

empty.title: No links yet
empty.description: Create a link to see its metrics here.

total.label: Total clicks
total.description: Clicks in the selected period that match the filters.
total.noPrevious: No clicks in the previous {{days}} days

average.label: Daily average
average.description: Total clicks divided by the days in the period.

peak.label: Best day
peak.description: The day of the period with the most clicks.

topCountry.label: Top country
topCountry.description: The country that brought the most clicks.

map.title: Clicks by country
map.description: Click a country to filter by it.

create.description: Organizations hold your links, domains and API keys.
create.title: New organization

edit.title: Edit organization
edit.description: Change the name or description of this organization.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: This permanently deletes the organization with its links, domains and API keys. It can't be undone.

empty.title: Create an organization first
empty.description: Organizations hold your links, users and API keys. Create one to start using this page.

users.title: Users
users.description: People with access to this organization.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.description: We will email them an invitation to join this organization.

delete.label: Remove user
delete.title: Remove {{name}}?
delete.description: They will lose access to this organization.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Keys to use the API from your own apps.

create.title: New API key
create.description: Pick a name and what the key is allowed to do.

created.title: Your API key
created.description: Copy it now: for security it won't be shown again.
created.label: API key

delete.label: Delete API key
delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Apps using this key will stop working. It can't be undone.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.label: Delete account
danger.description: Permanently deletes your account. You will lose the data and access you have created, and this can't be undone.

code.title: Confirm with the code
code.description: We emailed you a verification code. Enter it to delete your account.

links.title: Links
links.empty: No links yet. Create the first one.

create.title: New link
create.description: Paste a long URL and, if you want, shape how the short link behaves.

alias.label: Custom alias
alias.hint: Leave empty for a random code. 3 to 15 letters, numbers, - or _ (not 7 characters).
alias.invalid: Use 3 to 15 letters, numbers, - or _ (not 7 characters)

domain.label: Domain
domain.hint: Type a new domain to add it. Verify it in Domains before use.

password.label: Password
password.placeholder: Ask for a password to open it

channel.label: Channel
channel.required: Choose a channel for this campaign

preview.label: Final destination
preview.tooLong: This destination is longer than {{max}} characters with the campaign parameters. Shorten the URL or the channel name.

delete.label: Delete link
delete.title: Delete /{{code}}?
delete.description: The short link will stop working. It can't be undone.

unlock.title: Unlock page
unlock.description: Custom HTML shown to visitors who must enter the password.
unlock.label: HTML
unlock.notProtected: This link has no password, so visitors never see this page.

channelDialog.title: Change campaign
channelDialog.description: Putting the link in a channel adds utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign to its destination. The short link and its QR code don't change.
channelDialog.leaving: Taking the link out of its campaign removes utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign from its destination. Values the link had for them before it joined the campaign aren't restored.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Use your own domain for short links.

create.title: Add a domain
create.description: Enter the domain, then create the DNS record we show you.

host.label: Domain
host.invalid: Enter a valid domain, without https://

verify.label: Verify domain
verify.failed: We couldn't find the DNS record yet. DNS changes can take a while.

delete.label: Delete domain
delete.title: Delete {{host}}?
delete.description: Links using this domain will stop working. It can't be undone.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Group links by initiative and compare how each channel performs.

create.title: New campaign
create.description: A campaign groups the links you share for one initiative. Add channels to it afterwards.

edit.label: Edit campaign
edit.title: Edit campaign
edit.description: Links already in this campaign keep the campaign name they were given. A new name only applies to links you put in its channels from now on.

delete.label: Delete campaign
delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Its channels are removed. Its links stay and keep working, but are no longer part of a campaign. It can't be undone.

notFound.title: Campaign not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another organization.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: A channel is a place you share this campaign, such as Instagram or email. Its name is added to each link's destination as utm_source.
channels.empty: No channels yet. Add the first one to start putting links in this campaign.

delete.label: Delete channel
delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Its links stay and keep working, but are no longer part of this campaign. It can't be undone.

links.title: Links
links.description: Links shared in this campaign, with the channel each one was put in.
links.empty: No links in this campaign yet.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: Clicks on every link in this campaign. Compare how each channel performs.

channels.title: Clicks by channel
channels.empty: This campaign has no channels yet.
channels.more: And {{count}} more channels with fewer clicks.

channelForm.title: Add a channel
channelForm.description: Name the place you will share this campaign. The name becomes the utm_source of its links.

toast.qrFailed: Could not download the QR code

qr.title: QR Codes
qr.description: The QR code of every link. Download it or style it with your colors and logo.
qr.empty: Every link comes with a QR code. Create your first link and it shows up here.

style.title: Customize QR code
style.logoHint: An https image shown in the middle of the code. If the host blocks downloads from other sites, the PNG is saved without it.
style.lowContrast: The code must be darker than the background, with enough contrast to scan.

errors.providerMismatch: That email is registered with another sign-in method
errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong or expired
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one.
errors.codeTooSoon: A code was requested too recently. Wait a minute.
errors.googleEmailNotVerified: The Google email is not verified
errors.nameTaken: That name is already in use
errors.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 100 characters
errors.invalidDescription: The description can have up to 500 characters
errors.tooManyChannels: A campaign can have up to 100 channels
errors.campaignUrlTooLong: The destination with the campaign parameters is longer than 255 characters
errors.campaignsDisabled: Campaigns are not enabled on this server
errors.invalidRange: Choose a period of up to 366 days that ends after it starts
